pages.text: Click using /dev/null to open the inventory. There's a single inventory slot - put an item in there - dirt, for example. As you gather dirt from the ground this slot will fill up. Once it's full, any more dirt you pick up will be automatically discarded. You can
pages.title: item.openblocks.dev_null

pages.text: shift-click with the item in your hand as though you were placing the block!
